sloka: स शरो रावणं हत्वा रुधिरार्दीकृतच्छविः ।कृतकर्मा निभृतवत् स्वतूणीं पुनरागमत् ।। ६.१११.२० ।।
transliteration: sa śaro rāvaṇaṁ hatvā rudhirārdīkṛtacchaviḥ ।kṛtakarmā nibhṛtavat svatūṇīṁ punarāgamat ।। 6.111.20 ।।

translations.english: That arrow which was capable of putting an end to the body took out Ravana's life and smeared with blood, it entered the earth.
